AR-RMDB01B.title: B&D 4335A 433MHz 4-Button Transmitter
AR-RMDB01B.features:
• Genuine or high-quality compatible replacement
  • Secure billion code / rolling code technology
  • Controls up to 4 doors
  • Compact, durable design
  • Battery included
  • Easy programming
  • Australian stock
  • 12-month warranty
AR-RMDB01B.compatibility:
Compatible with the following B&D systems:

  • ✅ Controll-A-Door 4 (CAD4)
  • ✅ Controll-A-Door 5 (CAD5)
  • ✅ Controll-A-Door R (CAD R)
  • ✅ Controll-A-Door P (CAD P)
  • ✅ Controll-A-Door Shed Master
  • ✅ FAM4 / FAM5 / FAM P / FAM R / FAM RDO
  • ✅ EL4 / EL5 / EL R
  • ✅ EASYLIFTER
  • ✅ FIRMAMATIC
AR-RMDB01B.instructions:
📖 Programming Instructions

  1. Press and hold the desired button on your new remote.
  2. Press and release the orange Learn or CODE SET button on the opener panel.
  3. Wait for the opener light to flash or two clicks to be heard, then release the remote button.
  4. Test the remote operation.

⚠️ Important Information

  • Please check your B&D opener model before ordering.
  • The appearance of your existing remote does not always determine compatibility.
  • Incorrect model or frequency selection may result in the remote not working.
  • If you're unsure which remote you need, contact our team before purchasing.
